about: Open Food Facts (world.openfoodfacts.org) is an open, crowd-sourced food products database. This CLI reads product detail pages and their related data (Robotoff questions, folksonomy tags), the reference lists (countries, food-preference attribute groups, preference levels, external knowledge sources) and the bulk data-dump links.

commands.summary: Get a food product's name, common name and Nutri-Score breakdown by barcode (EAN/UPC), parsed from its product page
List the Robotoff machine-generated questions (for example a suggested category or label to confirm) that are pending for a product barcode

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code for the question text, e.g. en, fr

commands.summary: List the countries Open Food Facts supports, as a map from country code (e.g. us, fr) to English country name
List the product attribute groups used for personalized ranking (nutritional quality, processing, allergens, environment, …) with their attributes and allowed values
List the importance levels a user can assign to a product attribute (not important, important, very important, mandatory) with their scoring factors
List the external knowledge-panel providers (for example the animal-welfare Suffering Footprint) and the product filters each one applies to

params.name: lc
params.description: Language code for names and descriptions, e.g. en, fr

commands.summary: List the nightly database dump and export downloads (MongoDB dump, CSV, JSONL, …) with their download and checksum links
